title: 8D8
subtitle: Independent
description: A slender and spindly white Droid, 8D8 was in the unfortunate service of Jabba the Hutt, torturing other Droids alongside EY-9D9. However, following Jabba's death, the palace and all of Jabba's assets were eventually commandered by the ex-bounty hunter Boba Fett, who made himself daimyo and reassigned 8D8 to the more pleasant task of diplomacy.
